claims.claim: Within the Shaagat HaAri defining period the qualifying period was cut to 3 months out of 18 for special populations: operation evacuees, people with disabilities receiving a BL or MoD allowance, spouses of reservists who served 90+ days in the preceding year, MoD-recognized hostile-action casualties and disabled IDF veterans since 7 October and their spouses, and soldiers discharged within the last year.

claims.claim: For these special populations entitlement is granted in full, without deducting the first 5 days, and also for those who did not use up vacation days.

These numbers are computed by applying the official bracket percentages and daily ceilings quoted in the entries above to a chosen example salary; they are not published by Bituach Leumi and must be recomputed if any bracket or ceiling changes. ₪0 appears as the benefit for a claimant who fails the qualifying period.

claims.claim: The Shaagat HaArie business assistance scheme was finally approved in the Knesset; advances of up to 80% of the estimated compensation can be requested and final claims from 17 May.
claims.raw_snippet: באמצעות המערכת יוכלו בעלי העסקים שמחזור פעילותם נפגע בשל המלחמה לקבל מקדמה על חשבון הפיצוי עד שיעור של 80% מהפיצוי המשוער. הגשת תביעות סופיות תתאפשר החל מה-17 במאי, לאחר הגשת הדיווחים למע"מ בגין מרץ-אפריל 2026.
